def extract_grid(txt, start_pattern, end_pattern=None):
 s=re.search(start_pattern,txt).start() if re.search(start_pattern,txt) else None
 if s is None: raise ValueError(start_pattern)
 tail=txt[s:]
 if end_pattern: tail=tail[:re.search(end_pattern,tail).start()]
 lines=tail.splitlines(); m=re.search(r'\((\d+)x(\d+)\)',lines[0]); h,w=map(int,m.groups())
 rows=[]
 for line in lines[1:]:
  vals=[int(x) for x in line.split() if x.isdigit()]
  if len(vals)==w: rows.append(vals)
  if len(rows)==h: break
 return rows

code='''import collections

def _line_indices(grid, axis):
    n = len(grid) if axis == 0 else len(grid[0])
    modes = []
    for i in range(n):
        line = grid[i] if axis == 0 else [row[i] for row in grid]
        modes.append(collections.Counter(line).most_common(1)[0][0])
    counts = collections.Counter(modes)
    line_color = min(counts, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    return [i for i, c in enumerate(modes) if c == line_color], line_color

def transform(grid):
    rows, row_color = _line_indices(grid, 0)
    cols, col_color = _line_indices(grid, 1)
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            color = corners[0]
            if all(value == color for value in corners) and color not in (row_color, col_color):
                out_row.append(color)
            else:
                out_row.append(9)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
